rows.q: Why doesn't requests cache a default SSLContext?
rows.headline: Revert caching a default SSLContext — decided 2025-06-13 in #6767 by Nate Prewitt. This overrides an earlier decision ("Avoid reloading root certificates to improve concurrent performance", 2024-05-15), which you may still find quoted in older docs.

rows.q: Does requests reuse a global SSLContext when verify is True?
rows.headline: Revert caching a default SSLContext — decided 2025-06-13 in #6767 by Nate Prewitt. This overrides an earlier decision ("Avoid reloading root certificates to improve concurrent performance", 2024-05-15), which you may still find quoted in older docs.

top.text: 2.32.0: `verify=True` now reuses a global SSLContext which should improve request time variance between first and subsequent requests. It should also minimize certificate load time on Windows systems when using a Python version built with OpenSSL 3.x. (#6667)

rows.q: Why does requests use charset_normalizer instead of chardet?
rows.headline: Switch LGPL'd chardet for MIT licensed charset_normalizer — decided 2021-07-06 in #5797 by Ash Berlin-Taylor.

top.text: added handling for chardet and charset_normalizer imports

rows.q: Why is get_connection deprecated?
rows.headline: Move _get_connection to get_connection_with_tls_context — decided 2024-05-21 in #6710 by Nate Prewitt. This overrides an earlier decision ("Use TLS settings in selecting connection pool", 2024-03-11), which you may still find quoted in older docs.

rows.q: Why is the requests[security] extra a no-op?
rows.headline: The `requests[security]` extra has been converted to a no-op install — decided 2021-07-13 in the 2.26.0 release notes by Nate Prewitt.

top.text: 2.4.1: Now has a "security" package extras set, `$ pip install requests[security]`

rows.q: Why was proxy credential handling changed in 2.31.0?
rows.headline: Versions of Requests between v2.3.0 and v2.30.0 are vulnerable to potential forwarding of `Proxy-Authorization` headers to destination servers when following HTTPS redirects — decided 2023-05-22 in the 2.31.0 release notes by Nate Prewitt.

top.text: Add Proxy-Auth header when proxies have credentials.

rows.q: Why does pinning for chardet and idna use the major version?
rows.headline: Pinning for `chardet` and `idna` now uses major version instead of minor — decided 2020-02-19 in the 2.23.0 release notes by Nate Prewitt.

top.text: 2.23.0: Pinning for `chardet` and `idna` now uses major version instead of minor. This hopefully reduces the need for releases every time a dependency is updated.

rows.q: Why was the default User-Agent changed?
rows.headline: Update default user-agent (#2785) — decided 2015-10-05 in #2803 by Ian Cordasco, Alexandre Sieira. This overrides an earlier decision ("Have User Agent include more details", 2012-07-08), which you may still find quoted in older docs.

rows.q: Why does the chardet upper limit keep increasing?
rows.headline: The history shows what happened — "Increase chardet upper limit to 8" on 2026-03-03 in b2a1d33f by Dan Blanchard — but nobody wrote down why. Ask Dan Blanchard.

rows.q: Why is DEFAULT_POOLSIZE 10?
rows.headline: requests.adapters.DEFAULT_POOLSIZE was introduced on 2012-12-15 in "base adapter" by Kenneth Reitz (value history: 10 since 2012-12-15). No commit, pull request or release note records why. Ask Kenneth Reitz.

rows.q: Why is the retry limit three?
rows.headline: Check the premise: requests.adapters.DEFAULT_RETRIES is 0, not 3. requests.adapters.DEFAULT_RETRIES was introduced on 2012-12-15 in "base adapter" by Kenneth Reitz (value history: 0 since 2012-12-15). No commit, pull request or release note records why. Ask Ian Cordasco.

rows.q: Why was get_os_ca_bundle_path removed?
rows.headline: requests.utils.get_os_ca_bundle_path was introduced on 2012-04-22 in "attempt to use the OS's certificate bundle" by Shivaram Lingamneni. It was removed on 2012-12-23 in "clean up code support for OS certificate bundles" by Shivaram Lingamneni. No commit, pull request or release note records why. Ask Shivaram Lingamneni.
